description: After report approval and explicit renter consent, request human tour coordination for selected apartments. Include preferred dates, times and timezone in preferred_times. Uses the existing private research key and contact. One handoff per research report; identical retries return the existing request, changed preferences require staff follow-up. No appointment is booked or message sent.

consent.description: True only after the renter explicitly agrees to tour coordination using their saved contact.

preferred_times.description: Renter-provided preferred dates, times and timezone; preferences are not confirmed appointments.
preferred_times.title: Preferred Times

request_id.description: ID of the approved research request.
request_id.title: Request Id

request_key.description: Original private research access key. Never share publicly.
